`supportsArtifactBuild()` permits frontend/resource work but requires a normal build for native code, WebIDL, build files, Cargo/CMake/Gecko changes, or uncertainty. Artifact mode uses isolated sibling `obj-tb-tools`, compatibility keys, and immutable completed `binaries-<key>` snapshots; never copy a live object directory with embedded paths/symlinks between checkouts.
